narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms developed into portions of eastern Oklahoma during the morning hours of the 29th, along and ahead of a cold front moving into the area. Weak instability and strong wind shear combined to allow the storms to become organized, with the strongest producing several tornadoes, large hail up to golf ball size, and damaging wind gusts.
ev: Numerous streets were flooded in and around Hominy. Highway 99 was flooded near the high school.
lsr: Numerous areas of street flooding in Hominy. Water over Highway 99 near the high school.
